panels.title: Traders acompanhados
panels.description: Perfis lead_consensus (D-052): seguem os melhores lead traders do Copy Trading Spot da Binance e só compram o que pelo menos dois deles compraram e os candles do próprio par confirmam. Tamanho, stop e alvo são do perfil: nenhuma operação é copiada.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(jsonb_array_length(payload->'selected')), 0)::int AS traders FROM events WHERE id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM events WHERE kind = 'leads.selected' GROUP BY payload->>'profile')

panels.title: Última leitura dos traders
panels.description: Status da leitura que o último ciclo usou ('ok' ou o motivo de não haver entrada) e quantos traders acompanhados tinham leitura recente.

targets.rawSql: SELECT payload->'leads'->>'status' AS status, (payload->'leads'->>'fresh')::int AS com_leitura FROM events WHERE kind = 'decision.cycle' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'leads') = 'object' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) AS posicoes, coalesce(sum(entry_quote), 0)::float AS custo FROM positions WHERE state NOT IN ('closed', 'rejected') AND profile IN ('lead1h')
SELECT coalesce(sum(realized_pnl), 0)::float AS pnl FROM positions WHERE state = 'closed' AND realized_pnl IS NOT NULL AND profile IN ('lead1h') AND $__timeFilter(closed_at)

panels.title: Traders acompanhados agora
panels.description: A última seleção de cada perfil: nota (0 a 1), ROI e drawdown dos 90 dias do ranking, Sharpe, semanas positivas e ganho dos últimos 30 dias da curva de PnL, e o dinheiro do próprio trader no portfólio (USDT).

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.payload->>'profile' AS perfil, t->>'nickname' AS trader, t->>'id' AS portfolio, (t->>'score')::float AS nota, (t->>'roi_pct')::float AS roi_pct, (t->>'mdd_pct')::float AS drawdown_pct, (t->>'sharpe')::float AS sharpe, (t->>'positive_weeks')::float * 100 AS semanas_positivas_pct, (t->>'recent_gain_pct')::float AS ganho_30d_pct, (t->>'balance')::float AS saldo_proprio, (t->>'trading_days')::int AS dias FROM events e, jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'selected') t WHERE e.id IN (SELECT max(id) FROM events WHERE kind = 'leads.selected' GROUP BY payload->>'profile') ORDER BY 1, 4 DESC, 2

panels.title: Fonte de copy trading
panels.description: Leituras em que todas as requisições à fonte (endpoints do site da Binance, não documentados) falharam, e a volta. Sem leitura recente, o perfil não abre entradas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, payload->>'profile' AS perfil, CASE kind WHEN 'leads.source_unavailable' THEN 'indisponível' ELSE 'voltou a responder' END AS fonte FROM events WHERE kind IN ('leads.source_unavailable', 'leads.source_recovered') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Consenso dos traders por ciclo
panels.description: Ativos com consenso de compra (compradores menos vendedores ≥ min_backers), de venda, e movimentados sem consenso, a cada ciclo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.created_at AS time, count(a.key) FILTER (WHERE a.value->>'consensus' = 'buy') AS compra, count(a.key) FILTER (WHERE a.value->>'consensus' = 'sell') AS venda, count(a.key) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(a.value->'consensus') = 'null') AS sem_consenso FROM events e LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(e.payload->'leads'->'assets') a ON true WHERE e.kind = 'decision.cycle' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'leads') = 'object' AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY e.id, e.created_at ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Leitura dos traders por ciclo
panels.description: Ciclos que decidiram com a leitura dos traders e ciclos sem ela (ranking vencido, nenhum trader selecionado ou fonte sem dados recentes): esses não abrem entradas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE payload->'leads'->>'status' = 'ok') AS com_leitura, count(*) FILTER (WHERE payload->'leads'->>'status' <> 'ok') AS sem_leitura FROM events WHERE kind = 'decision.cycle' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'leads') = 'object' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Decisões por ativo
panels.description: Cada ativo que os traders acompanhados movimentaram, em cada ciclo: quem comprou e quem vendeu (ids dos portfólios), o preço médio que pagaram e o que o ciclo fez. 'candles recusaram' é o consenso que o agente decidiu não seguir; 'recusada' é a recusa do planejamento ou do Risk Guard (preço além do que os traders pagaram, vagas, orçamento).

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.created_at AS time, e.payload->>'profile' AS perfil, e.payload->>'state' AS estado, a.key AS ativo, COALESCE(a.value->>'consensus', 'nenhum') AS consenso, jsonb_array_length(a.value->'buyers') AS compradores, jsonb_array_length(a.value->'sellers') AS vendedores, (a.value->>'avg_buy_price')::float AS preco_traders, COALESCE( CASE WHEN e.payload->'opened' @> jsonb_build_array(a.key) THEN 'entrada aberta' END, (SELECT x->>1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'exits') x WHERE x->>0 = a.key LIMIT 1), (SELECT 'recusada: ' || (x->>1) FROM jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'rejected') x WHERE x->>0 = a.key LIMIT 1), (SELECT 'candles recusaram: ' || (x->>1) FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(e.payload->'filtered', '[]'::jsonb)) x WHERE x->>0 = a.key LIMIT 1), CASE a.value->>'consensus' WHEN 'buy' THEN 'compra sem entrada' WHEN 'sell' THEN 'venda sem posição' ELSE 'sem consenso' END ) AS decisao, array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.value->'buyers')), ', ') AS compraram, array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(a.value->'sellers')), ', ') AS venderam FROM events e, jsonb_each(e.payload->'leads'->'assets') a WHERE e.kind = 'decision.cycle' AND jsonb_typeof(payload->'leads') = 'object' AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, a.key LIMIT 500

panels.title: Ordens e trades do copy trading
panels.description: Posições dos perfis lead_consensus: as abertas e as que mudaram no período (encerradas e entradas FOK não executadas).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(opened_at, created_at) AS time, symbol AS ativo, profile AS perfil, state AS estado, entry_price::float AS entrada, exit_price::float AS saida, (policy->>'stop_pct')::float AS stop_pct, (policy->>'take_profit_pct')::float AS alvo_pct, entry_quote::float AS custo, realized_pnl::float AS pnl, exit_reason AS motivo, closed_at AS encerrada_em FROM positions WHERE profile IN ('lead1h') AND (state NOT IN ('closed', 'rejected') OR $__timeFilter(updated_at)) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Seleções de traders
panels.description: Cada leitura do ranking (a cada 6 h): portfólios lidos, candidatos examinados, traders seguidos e quantos portfólios cada critério recusou.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, payload->>'profile' AS perfil, (payload->>'pool')::int AS ranking, (payload->>'examined')::int AS examinados, jsonb_array_length(payload->'selected') AS seguidos, (SELECT string_agg(r.key || ': ' || r.value, ', ' ORDER BY r.value::int DESC, r.key) FROM jsonb_each_text(payload->'rejected') r) AS recusas FROM events WHERE kind = 'leads.selected' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
